name: thesis_commit
title: Commit a verifiable market thesis
description: Tamper-evident commitment of an agent's reasoning BEFORE the market moves. Given a symbol, a natural-language thesis, and optional conviction/horizon/evidence references, returns a sha256 commitment plus a hash-chained receipt proving the thesis existed at commit time — 'early, not wrong' as a platform primitive. Returns the same public envelope as the six published tools (schema_version, tool, status, data_mode, as_of, request, data, summary, availability, warnings) at the same call convention (POST /tools/thesis_commit/call), so mounting is mechanical: no caller changes, no required adoption of the producer's ledger — the receipt embeds its hashes and a verify recipe in data.

symbol.description: Ticker the thesis covers (max 14 chars), e.g. 'HYPE'.

horizon_hours.description: Optional resolution window in hours — after it, the thesis is checkable against outcome.

evidence_refs.description: Optional digests/URIs of the evidence used (e.g. 'analyze_token:rest:693f8d49b2ae').

data.commitment: sha256 over canonical thesis payload — cite this
data.price_at_commit: number | null — sealed reference price for thesis_resolve's evidence check (via analyze_token; null = unverifiable, named in warnings)

verify.hash_spec: self-contained: entry.hash = sha256(prevHash + canonical-json(entry)) — a verifier needs no repo clone

warnings: non-empty when the chain was already broken at commit time, or price_at_commit couldn't be fetched

safety.network: none required (anchoring optional via anchorAll env-gating)

companion_tool.name: thesis_resolve
companion_tool.title: Resolve a committed thesis
companion_tool.description: Closes the debate loop: given a commitment (or receipt hash) from thesis_commit, records the outcome the thesis actually met — validated | invalidated | mixed | expired. Evidence-checked, not self-reported: when the commit sealed price_at_commit, resolve fetches the live price via analyze_token, computes the actual move (±5% band), and flags the result contested when the claimed outcome disagrees with the evidence. Unavailable prices are recorded as claimed-unverified, never fabricated. One-shot: a commitment resolves exactly once, so debates stay honest. Same public envelope and call convention (POST /tools/thesis_resolve/call).

commitment.description: sha256 commitment or receipt hash returned by thesis_commit.

note.description: Optional resolution note — what actually happened.

statuses.partial: thesis already resolved (one-shot refused) or chain degraded
statuses.unavailable: no such commitment on this ledger

price_check.rule: move_pct = (price_at_resolve - price_at_commit) / price_at_commit; >= +5% validated, <= -5% invalidated, else mixed
price_check.fields: data.price_check = { price_at_commit, price_at_resolve, move_pct, computed_outcome, claimed_outcome, agreed }
price_check.contested: when agreed === false the RESOLVE entry carries contested:true and the disagreement is named in warnings

companion_tool.lookup: GET /ryo/commitment/{hash} → open/resolved status without a write
companion_tool.debate_view: GET /ryo/debate/{symbol} → the full reasoning timeline for a symbol, with commit/resolve forms that post to these same endpoints
